# Sourcepilot

Sourcepilot is a browser extension for comparing, deduplicating and ranking suppliers selected from Alibaba and 1688.

Canonical website: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/
Tutorials: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/tutorials.html
Alibaba guide: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/alibaba-supplier-ranking.html
1688 guide: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/1688-supplier-ranking.html
Deduplication guide: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/supplier-deduplication.html
Pricing: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/#pricing
Privacy: https://sourcepilot-app.github.io/privacy.html

Core capabilities:
- Quantity-aware price comparison
- Marketplace-specific Alibaba and 1688 processing
- Automatic supplier deduplication
- Standard, Price Focused and Quality Focused ranking profiles
- Server-generated CSV export on eligible plans
- Chrome, Microsoft Edge and Mozilla Firefox support

Sourcepilot is independent and is not affiliated with Alibaba.com or 1688.com.
